ItHowlsInTheRain_Scene6.source: 'Oh, it's just you, Gary... *pant* *pant*... Stop grabbing my arm!'
ItHowlsInTheRain_Scene6.translation: „O, ești doar tu, Gary... *gâfâit* *gâfâit*... Nu mă mai apuca de braț!”
